title: A University's Buffs stop at five
notes: meditative-097-6 University: its times param gets max 5 (its Radiant value), and an Activate N counts at most ACTIVATE_UNLIMITED_CAP uses a turn, so its own Buffs no longer feed a turn that never ends (R884000).

player.title: University's Buffs capped
balance: University's number of Buffs can be Buffed up to 5, its Radiant value, and never past it.
fixes: An Activate ability Buffed past 100 uses is used at most 100 times a turn, so a University that keeps Buffing itself no longer stalls the game.
